name: The Sacred Flame
summary: Zangen Stonehoof sends the Horde after a sacred flame and an ancient relic. To aid Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles, you seek a moonwell phial in Ashenvale.

sections.title: Centaur Relics and Elven Waters
sections.body: The Galak centaur guard an ancient relic in Thousand Needles. Their artifact dates to the creation of their race, and they protect it with sacred flames. Zangen Stonehoof needs water touched by lunar divinity to extinguish those flames. He sends you north to Ashenvale, where the ancestral forests hold the moonwell water he seeks.

sections.title: Trespassing in Ashenvale
sections.body: Pure moonwell water needs a vessel that will not corrupt it. You seek an etched phial from the Laughing Sisters, dryads near Raynewood Retreat. Then you submerge the phial in a moonwell along the western banks of the Falfarren River and carry it back to Mulgore.

faq.q: Why does Zangen Stonehoof need moonwell water?
faq.answer: Zangen needs moonwell water for his associate Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles. Rau plans to use its potent magic to extinguish the sacred flame guarded by the hostile Galak centaur, so the Horde can recover an ancient relic.

faq.q: Where can the etched phial be found?
faq.answer: The etched phial is carried by the Laughing Sisters, dryads who wander the woods around Raynewood Retreat in central Ashenvale, just off the northern road leading west from Splintertree Post.

faq.q: Which moonwell should be used to fill the phial?
faq.answer: The moonwell lies near the western bank of the Falfarren River, south of the main road across central Ashenvale.

The Galak are an aggressive centaur clan in the dusty expanses of Thousand Needles. They guard an ancient relic from the founding era of their kind, ringed by a sacred bonfire that Zangen and Rau intend to douse.

faq.q: Who receives the filled phial after Zangen?
aliases: where does the water go next
faq.answer: After Zangen inspects the filled phial in Thunder Bluff, he sends you south to Thousand Needles to deliver it to Rau Cliffrunner, who requested it.

faq.q: Why kill dryads for their phials?
faq.answer: Dryad vessels are specially made to hold pure, enchanted liquids without tainting them. Ordinary bottles cannot safely carry water imbued with the celestial energies of a night elf moonwell.

angles.text: Centaur hostility has plagued the tauren for generations. A relic from the centaur race's genesis can give Mulgore's tribes insight into their foes and leverage against them.
Tauren druids face an uneasy choice: slay nature's daughters, the dryads, to gather sanctified waters for a strike against the centaur's sacred flames.
Trouble around Raynewood Retreat risks inflaming night elf tensions in Ashenvale. Centaur relics in Thousand Needles bolster the Horde's southern frontiers.
